## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes, and new behaviour has tests
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass (if the frontend changed)
- [ ] A schema change comes with an Alembic revision; no applied revision was edited
- [ ] README and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real target data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
- [ ] The change does not weaken the target authorization gate, input validation or the production container hardening
